name: Daily driver
instructions: Set the AeroPress in the standard position on a server.
Start a timer and pour {{water}} of water, making sure to wet all grounds.
Immediately insert the plunger about 1 cm in to create a vacuum.
Wait 2 minutes, then gently swirl the brewer.
Wait 30 seconds, then press gently for about 30 seconds.

name: Two Big Cups - One Brew
instructions: Preheat the server and AeroPress with warm water.
Rinse the paper filter and place the AeroPress on the server.
Add {{coffee}} of coffee, then pour {{water:0.625}} of the water.
Stir gently for 15 seconds and insert the plunger to stop dripping.
At 2 minutes, press for 30~40 seconds.
Add the remaining {{water:0.375}} of water, then serve.

name: Two Big Cold Cups - One Brew
instructions: Preheat the AeroPress with warm water.
Place {{ice}} of ice in the server.
Rinse the paper filter and place the AeroPress on the server.
Add {{coffee}} of coffee, then pour {{water}} of the water.
Stir gently for 15 seconds and insert the plunger to stop dripping.
At 2 minutes, press for 30~40 seconds.
Swirl to melt the ice and serve over fresh ice.

name: James Hoffmann's Iced AeroPress
instructions: Put {{ice}} of ice in a decanter, then set the AeroPress in the standard position on top; do not rinse the filter.
Boil the water, add {{coffee}} of coffee to the AeroPress, and level the bed.
Pour {{water}} of water straight off the boil, wetting all the coffee.
Start a timer and immediately insert the plunger.
Wait 4 minutes
Gently swirl the brewer, wait 30 seconds, then press gently all the way.
Swirl to melt the ice and serve over fresh ice.

name: Cold Brew
instructions: Insert {{coffee}} of ground coffee in the Mizudashi filter.
Pour {{water}} of room-temperature water.
Let it rest for {{time}}.

name: Daniela's Mugen
instructions: Rinse the filter with hot water and discard the rinse water.
Add {{coffee}} of coffee to the filter.
Start a timer and pour {{water}} of water for 40 seconds.
Wait for the remaining brew time, then serve.
